questions.q: Why did one of the pirates come back in to borrow the torch?
choices: The fire outside had burned too low to see by
They wanted to use it to burn down the block house
They needed it to send a signal to the ship
Silver had told them to take it outside with them
questions.evidence: I understood why these conspirators desired a torch

questions.q: Through the loophole, what did Jim see the kneeling pirate holding?
choices: A book and an open knife
A pistol and a folded map
A bottle and a tin cup
A coil of rope and a lantern
questions.evidence: he had a book as well as a knife in his hand

questions.q: Why did Jim step away from the loophole when the pirates came back?
choices: It was beneath his dignity to be caught watching
He was afraid they would fire through the loophole
Silver ordered him to sit down and keep still
He wanted to hide in the dark behind the door
questions.evidence: it seemed beneath my dignity that they should find me watching them

questions.q: What did the pirates hand to Silver?
choices: The black spot
A loaded pistol
The treasure map
A bag of gold coins
questions.evidence: The black spot! I thought so

questions.q: Why did Silver and Morgan think the black spot was unlucky this time?
choices: It had been cut out of a Bible
It was written in a dead man's blood
It was handed over at midnight
It had been dropped in the fire first
questions.evidence: You've gone and cut this out of a Bible

questions.q: The word written on the black spot was "Deposed." What does it mean here?
choices: Removed from being captain
Sentenced to death
Promoted to a higher rank
Sent away from the island

questions.q: Who was the leader of the pirates who were turning against Silver?
choices: George Merry
Tom Morgan
Dick Johnson
Israel Hands

questions.q: Which of these was one of George's complaints against Silver?
choices: He let the enemy out of the trap for nothing
He drank all the brandy and left none for them
He let the parrot escape into the woods
He refused to share out the salt pork fairly
questions.evidence: you let the enemy out o' this here trap for nothing

questions.q: How did Silver answer the charge that he had ruined the cruise?
choices: He blamed George, Hands and Anderson for forcing his hand
He admitted it was all his fault and begged for mercy
He blamed Jim for cutting the ship loose from her anchor
He said Captain Smollett had tricked them from the start
questions.evidence: it was Anderson, and Hands, and you, George Merry!

questions.q: Why did Silver say it would be foolish to kill Jim?
choices: Jim was a hostage who might be their last chance
Jim knew exactly where Flint's treasure was buried
Jim was the only one left who could sail the ship
Jim was Silver's nephew and he had promised his mother

questions.q: What did Silver throw onto the floor to prove he had made a good bargain?
choices: Flint's chart with the three red crosses
A heavy leather bag full of gold coins
The key to the HISPANIOLA's powder room
The doctor's medicine chest and its lock
questions.evidence: the chart on yellow paper, with the three red crosses

questions.q: How did the mutineers react when they saw the chart?
choices: They leaped on it like cats upon a mouse
They threw it straight into the fire
They ignored it and went on arguing
They tore it up and gave it back to Jim
questions.evidence: They leaped upon it like cats upon a mouse

questions.q: What happened right after Silver said he would resign as captain?
choices: The pirates cried out for him to stay captain
George Merry was quickly chosen as the new captain
The pirates turned on Jim with their knives drawn
Silver walked out of the block house into the night

questions.q: What words from the Bible page struck Jim sharply?
choices: Without are dogs and murderers
Thou shalt not steal from thy neighbour
The meek shall inherit the earth
Love thy neighbour as thyself

questions.q: How did Jim feel about Silver as he lay awake that night?
choices: His heart was sore for him, wicked as he was
He hated him and hoped he would be hanged
He trusted him completely, like a father
He did not think of him at all that night
questions.evidence: my heart was sore for him, wicked as he was

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The crew tries to depose Silver, but he wins them back and stays captain
Jim slips away while the pirates argue and returns safely to his friends
The pirates follow Flint's chart in the dark and dig up the treasure
Silver gives in to his crew and hands Jim over to George Merry
questions.evidence: keeping the mutineers together with one hand
